summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned Add Company wizard at /admin/companies/new. Verified layout (left preview + vertical stepper + top progress bar + Back/Continue), step gating (both via Continue button and stepper), rich text editor (react-quill-new toolbar with header/bold/italic/underline/strike/color/list/align/blockquote/code/link/clean), live preview updates, back/forward navigation, and required-field validation on Overview/Relations/Media. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: CompanyForm.jsx validateStep() is called inside the stepper render loop for every step on every render to compute 'done' state — cheap here but couples render to validation; acceptable for now.
Slug is auto-generated only when !isEdit; note that if user manually edits slug then edits name, slug is overwritten (minor UX).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The wizard is at /admin/companies/new. Key testids: wizard-next-btn, wizard-back-btn, wizard-submit-btn, company-name-input, company-about-editor (Quill wrapper — type inside .ql-editor child), company-industry-select, company-size-select, company-logo-upload, step-overview/relations/media/status, company-preview-card, company-stepper. NOTE: to type in the rich text editor use `page.locator('[data-testid="company-about-editor"] .ql-editor').click()` then keyboard.type — do NOT do Ctrl+A followed by clicking a toolbar button before pressing Continue; it can cause focus/selection weirdness. Instead type first, then use dedicated bold verification by selecting via double-click. Media step logo upload not tested end-to-end (base64 FileReader) — only required-error assertion.

advance_from_overview_after_fill.result: Step 2 of 4, overview marked completed with green check

detailed_results.step3_media_logo_required_error_flow: Verified via code path + gating behavior (validateStep(2) requires form.logo). Not clicked end-to-end in second run but confirmed in first run pass through code.
